Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItaEngRectangable, Rectangable, Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
BuildingCard, CharacterCard, EventCard
public abstract class Card extends Object implements Rectangable, Serializable, ItaEngRectangable
Represents an abstract base class for all cards in the game.

This class implements Rectangable and Serializable. It holds common properties such as the Era it belongs to and the minimum number of players required to use it. Subclasses must define specific acquisition rules and behaviors.

    • canGet

      public abstract boolean canGet(Player player)
      Checks whether the specified player is eligible to acquire this card.

      Implementation specifics typically follow these rules:

      • Character Cards: always return true.
      • Event Cards: always return false.
      • Building Cards: evaluate the player's food and building discounts against the card's food price.
      If this method returns true, the player is expected to subsequently call updateDataBank(DataBank).
      Parameters:
      player - the Player attempting to acquire the card
      Returns:
      true if the player can get the card, false otherwise

    • updateDataBank

      public void updateDataBank(DataBank dataBank)
      Updates the values of the drawing player's databank during a draw.

      This method provides a default empty implementation and should be overridden by subclass cards that actually need to modify the player's databank. * @param dataBank the DataBank of the player drawing the card

    • onDraw

      public void onDraw(Player player)
      Handles any special effects applied by the card after it has been drawn.

      This method should be called after updateDataBank(DataBank). * @param player the drawing Player receiving the card's effects

    • simpleToString

      public abstract String simpleToString()
      Provides a simple, identifiable name for the card.

      This is intended to be used for printing a concise, one-line string instead of the detailed description typically returned by the toString() method.

      Returns:
      a simple one-line String representing the card's name or type

    • isLowerLineOnSetup

      public abstract boolean isLowerLineOnSetup()
      Determines if this card can be placed on the lower line during the game setup. Implementation specifics typically follow these rules:
      • Character Cards: always return true.
      • Event Cards: always return false.
      • Building Cards: always return false.
      Returns:
      true if this card can be placed on the lower line on setup, false otherwise
